{{Top|leg}}
'''Sorin Schaff''' was the chief backer of the [[Citizens' Militia]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At one point, he was held captive in his own [[Schaff homestead|home]] by [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Braigin Helk]].<ref name="TOR:PB">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Pirate Bullies|Tatooine}}</ref>
